name: megascenes-valentine-card
description: Design Valentine's Day cards with their name, your message and your signature in the design, in the look you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give who the card is for, the main line, a short message and how you sign it, and pick the look: romantic red roses, pink watercolor hearts, minimal line art, vintage, a funny cartoon. You get a Valentine's Day card with your words set in the design, portrait, square or wide, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For your partner, a secret crush and the friends you love, on February 14th.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set the name, message and signature in the design
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: A romantic Valentine card with red roses for Sofia, signed Forever yours, Luca
A funny cartoon Valentine card that says You are my favorite person
A minimal line art Valentine card with the words Be mine

positive.prompt: A romantic Valentine card with red roses for Sofia, signed Forever yours, Luca. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Valentine card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A funny cartoon Valentine card that says You are my favorite person. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a Valentine card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The Valentine card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A square Valentine card with pink watercolor hearts, the words Be mine and the signature Love, Marco. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my Valentine card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my Valentine card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
